rawAnswer: {"findings":[{"kind":"defect","severity":"medium","title":"Pipeline steps cache ISymbol and re-run on every compilation","detail":"GeneratedFormatterRequest is a record that holds two INamedTypeSymbol values, and it is the cached output of the ForAttributeWithMetadataName step. The diagnostics pipeline then combines each request with CompilationProvider and runs GeneratedFormatterCollector again. Symbols are not stable from one compilation to the next, so this step never compares equal to its cached value. The collector re-runs on every keystroke, and both pipelines keep compilations alive. The checklist forbids holding an ISymbol or Compilation in cached output.
